verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs detail onboarding both W-2 employees (personal details, pay rates, tax withholding) and 1099 contractors (with direct deposit/check/historical payment methods), and describe processing regular, off-cycle, and contractor payment runs from the same platform/API (docs-44, docs-48, docs-9/18/26/51, docs-27). Platform overview explicitly lists 'Manage contractor payments' alongside standard payroll processing as a unified capability.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of running a single payroll batch mixing both employee and contractor payments, and no case study showing a real customer doing both simultaneously.
